campaign_local_verification_runner.why_outside_the_tooling_block: The plan's `tooling` block names exactly three scripts and this is a fourth. It is bound here rather than added to that block so the block still means what the plan says it means. It runs the Lab's own verifyTrustedLocalObservationRecord from @erl2/core, which is neither of the comparator's two permitted imports and is not one of the adapter's three provisioned peers, so it cannot be reached through the comparator's dependency anchor. It adds no assurance machinery and computes no verdict.
